description: This file defines the BarGridlinesRenderer class responsible for rendering gridlines on bar charts within the PDFsharp charting library. It includes methods for drawing gridlines based on axis scales and formatting.

classes.name: BarGridlinesRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders gridlines for bar charts, handling both X and Y axis gridlines with specified formatting.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Draws gridlines on the plot area based on axis scales and formatting.
